basic_info.description: Inviting and semi-detached three bedroom, three bath contemporary home with captivating views in a coveted Potrero hill location. The home opens to an open living/dining area with fireplace, a wall of windows with cascading natural light that showcases the picturesque and panoramic western views, and direct access to a private deck. On this same level is a spacious kitchen with views, a full-sized bathroom, a large bedroom with private deck, and a spacious master bedroom with en-suite bath. The lower level of the home has an entertainment room with a wet-bar, an additional full bathroom, and the third bedroom with a third private deck also with views. This level has separate access from the street level eliminating the need to use the stairs to access this portion of the home. There is deeded side-by-side garage parking for this unit and shared access to the garden/backyard area along with storage space.  Do not miss this truly special opportunity that is close to world class restaurants, cafes, shopping, parks, playgrounds, HWY 101/280 and more
